correctness.rationale: In K_m x K_n, every independent set lies in one row or column, so at most t empty labels, and total weight equals mn - z + d where d counts double labels. Equality mn-t forces maximal empty coordinate fiber and singleton other labels. An empty row is rainbow dominated precisely when both singleton colors occur in at least two distinct columns; inclusion-exclusion counts 2^((s-1)t)-2-2t(2^(s-1)-1), times s or 2s maximal fibers. For (2,2) and (2,3), direct structural exceptional graph analysis gives min4 and counts36,48. Independently enumerated all 4^N labelings for 2x2,2x3,2x4,3x3, reproducing respective minima and counts; corrects a prior overbroad lower-bound sharpness assertion.

evidence: Prior Theorem 3.1 in fact asserts lower-bound sharpness for all K_m x K_n, but the reasoning does not establish equality for (2,2),(2,3).
broader_coverage.reasoning: Independent exhaustive four-label enumeration gives gamma=4 for both exceptional graphs, while mn-max(m,n) would give 2 and 3. The exceptional corrections and exact counts are not covered by that asserted equality.
